title: New law: A bill to amend Section 201 of the Agricultural Act of 1949, as amended, to delete the requirement that the support price of milk be adjusted semiannually. (Public Law 97-6)
summary: S. 509 of the 97th Congress became Public Law 97-6 on 1981-03-31.

summary: H.R. 2166 of the 97th Congress became Public Law 97-5 on 1981-03-13.
